routes.name: TechIreland National AI Challenge 2026

source.summary: Live programme page says participants must be based in Northern Ireland or the Republic of Ireland; challenge begins 28 August 2026.

rules.label: Participant is based in Northern Ireland or the Republic of Ireland

next_actions: Verify the participant account and team state in the Challenge App.
Select Challenge 22 and preserve the provider acknowledgement.
Run the two-week prototype plan from 28 August to 14 September 2026.
routes.alternative_path: Use the public Challenge catalogue as a benchmark without representing participation.

routes.name: Invest NI Business Innovation Grant

source.summary: Official page states Northern Ireland micro and SME applicants, most sectors except primary agriculture, GBP 5,000 to GBP 20,000 grants at 70 percent, closing 4 September 2026 noon.

rules.label: Applicant is a micro business or SME
rules.evidence: Current employee, turnover and balance-sheet evidence

rules.label: Applicant is not in primary agriculture
Project aligns with the published innovation purpose
Requested grant is within the published range
rules.evidence: Costed project budget and grant calculation

rules.label: Applicant can fund the non-grant project share

next_actions: Run the official Innovate NI eligibility process.
Reconcile quotations, accounts and co-funding before any application.
Treat Invest NI as the final eligibility and award authority.
routes.alternative_path: Ask Invest NI for the correct client or innovation route if BIG is unavailable.

routes.name: EPSRC Future Computing Paradigms Network Plus

source.summary: UKRI requires an eligible UK research-organisation lead and a mandatory EOI by 11 September 2026 before the full 13 October deadline.

rules.label: Lead is based in the United Kingdom
Lead is an EPSRC-eligible research organisation
Mandatory EOI evidence is ready
rules.evidence: EOI owner, scope and submission confirmation

next_actions: Complete the mandatory EOI by 11 September 2026 at 23:59 UK time.
Keep commercial product development outside the funded scope.
Record non-academic organisations as project partners where appropriate.
routes.alternative_path: A business that cannot lead may participate through a verified eligible research-organisation lead as a project partner.

routes.name: Go Succeed Ultimate Pitch 2026

source.summary: Official page requires Go Succeed registration, a Northern Ireland council route and a startup or business operating for less than two years; applications close 21 August 2026 noon.

rules.label: Venture has operated for less than 24 months
Applicant is registered with Go Succeed
Applicant can attend the required heat and final dates

next_actions: Preserve the provider submission receipt and any correction acknowledgement.
Do not submit a duplicate entry.
Prepare the evidence-bounded pitch for the applicable local heat.
routes.alternative_path: Use Go Succeed mentoring and grant-support services if the competition route is closed.
